title: sent_alerts
description: Notification send record. Prevents duplicate notifications for the same listing, filter, channel, and content version.

filter_id.description: Alert filter that matched the listing.

channel.description: Notification channel. Telegram is the first channel.

message.description: Notification message body or attempted body.

error_message.description: Failure detail when status is failed.

attempt_count.description: Number of send attempts for this notification record.

content_hash_at_alert.description: Listing content_hash at notification time. Included in the unique key so meaningful listing changes can notify again.

examples.message: New sit matched: Auckland Central good sits
